name: Corporate Memphis
summary: Flat vector illustrations of people with oversized limbs and tiny heads, drawn in a bright palette of 4 to 6 hues with no outlines. Facebook's Alegria system set it in 2017, and many software firms copied it.

philosophy.core_thesis: Friendly, abstract people with unreal bodies make a corporate product feel human and inclusive without the risk of a specific face.
design_principles: Draw people with limbs 1.5 to 3 times longer than natural, hands and heads reduced to 10 to 15% of body height, and torsos of simple curved shapes.
Fill shapes with flat colour and use no outline, no gradient and no shading; add one 10% darker tone for a fold only when needed.
Colour skin in non-realistic tones such as purple, blue, green and orange, and use 4 to 6 hues across the whole scene.
Place figures with small plants, phone screens, charts and floating geometric shapes, scaled to be larger than the people.
Use curved, rounded outlines of shapes with a minimum 8px radius, and give limbs a stretched, noodle-like form.
Put the illustration at 40 to 60% of the width of a hero section and pair it with a left-aligned sans-serif headline.
Keep faces blank or reduced to a dot or a simple mark, with no detailed eyes or mouths.
anti_patterns: Realistic human proportions with a head of 12.5% of body height
Outlines, gradients and drop shadows on figures
Photographic faces in the illustrated hero
A single skin colour that is the same across all figures
Detailed facial expressions and fine eyelashes
More than 6 hues in one scene
Illustrations with hand-drawn texture or visible brush marks

layout.grid_mechanics: A 12-column web grid with 24px gutters and a 1200px maximum width; hero sections split into a 5-column text block and a 7-column illustration block.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 40–55% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 24, 48, 80, 120px, and illustrations sit in large clear areas.
layout.alignment_rules: Headlines and text sit flush left; illustrations are placed at the right or the centre, and figures overlap their container edges by 10 to 20% to break the box.
layout.container_geometry: Rounded rectangles with a 12 to 24px radius for cards and 999px pill buttons; background blobs of organic curved shapes sit behind the figures.

font_pairings.note: A round geometric display face with a neutral text face, the common choice in startup landing pages.
A single-family setting with low contrast and open shapes.
Rounded terminals that echo the soft limbs of the figures.

typography.tracking: Display sizes take -0.02em to 0em; body stays at 0; labels take +0.02em.
hierarchy_rules: Use bold (600 to 700) for headlines and regular (400) for body text.
Set headlines at 40 to 72px and body at 16 to 20px, with a ratio of at least 2.5 between them.
Set headlines in sentence case, in near-black or deep navy, never in the illustration palette.
Limit a headline to 8 to 12 words and a supporting line to 20 to 25 words.

color.palette_structure: A neutral white or very light base, a deep navy for text, and 4 to 6 saturated flat hues in illustration, with no hue on more than 25% of the scene.
color.contrast_rules: Text holds at least 4.5:1; Deep Navy on white reaches 14:1; light hues such as Marigold and Mint stay on illustration and never carry text.
color.surface_treatment: Opaque flat colour fields with no gradient and no outline; background blobs use one pale tint at 100% opacity.
color.light_and_shadow: None. There is no light source; at most one tone 10% darker marks an overlap or a fold.

materiality.surface_simulation: None; figures and objects are flat cut-out shapes that imitate vector paper cut-outs only in their silhouette.
materiality.border_rules: No outlines on illustration shapes; UI cards take a 1px border in #E5E7F0 or a soft 0 8px 24px shadow at 8% navy.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur on illustration; UI cards may use one shadow of 0 8px 24px at 8% opacity and no more than 2 elevation levels.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Solid duotone icons on a 24px grid with a 2px stroke and rounded terminals in navy and one accent hue.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Flat vector scenes of 1 to 4 figures with long arms and legs, tiny heads and non-realistic skin tones, shown with plants, devices and floating shapes.

motion.transition_physics: Soft, rounded movement: shapes float with a 2 to 4s sine loop of 8 to 12px, and sections fade and rise by 24px on scroll.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover lifts buttons by 2px and darkens the fill by 8%; active returns them to 0px; illustration elements shift by 4 to 8px with a gentle overshoot.

emotion.target_response: Friendly reassurance: the viewer feels that a large company is approachable, inclusive and low-risk.

avoid_when: The brand needs a distinct voice, because the style is the most copied look of the late 2010s.
The topic is serious, medical or financial and a playful tone would reduce trust.
The audience is design-literate and reads the style as generic or dismissive.

modifiers.how: Replace illustrated people with objective photography, reduce the palette to black, white and one accent, and set text flush left on a grid.
Add terrazzo speckle, zigzags and squiggles in saturated primaries with black outlines of 3px; keep the flat fills.
Replace figures with geometric icons and colour blocks of solid fills; keep the palette and the layout.
Place the illustration in cards with 1 to 4dp elevation and a coloured app bar; keep the flat vector figures.

pack.why: A friendly round line with one flat tint: the same two-tone logic as the illustrations.

ground.why: Corporate Memphis decorates the page with small floating shapes in friendly colours.
